verification: CI fixture HTTP through the FastAPI test client; tokens, grants and requests are fixture-local, not production.
assertions: An identical retry returns the same operation id with replayed true.
After a process restart the same request derives the same operation id and accepted request; nothing authoritative is written.
After revision 4 is accepted, revision 3 for the same task is refused 409 stale_task_revision and revision 4 replays.
BRAIN_TASK_CONTEXT=false returns 503 while the project feed answers 200; re-enabling restores the same operation id.
durability: Replay cache and revision guard are process memory; a restart keeps operation identity (derived) and loses replay flags and the stale guard.
